name: Shinobu Kocho

names.th: โคโจ ชิโนบุ

overview.desc: Shinobu has a skillset any debuffer would envy, not only being able to impede enemy healing in various ways but also able to apply so much Poison through various methods to keep their HP in check. Furthermore, with powerful multi-hit Single-Target skills, she can even take on the role as a single-target damage dealer.

builds.gear_notes: With 100% Crit Rate at T2 and the ability to reduce enemy Effect Resistance, it only feels natural to boost her Weakness Hit Chance as well to allow her to also become a powerful Single-Target hitter while inflicting loads of Poison on the enemy.

builds.name: Lethal Single-Target
builds.gear_notes: A PVE-specialised build that turns her into a powerful Single-Target damage dealer against bosses, making use of her high damage multipliers and also increasing her Poison damage.

builds.name: Swift & Potent
builds.gear_notes: T6 Shinobu needs just some Speed so as to take her Basic Attack earlier to get Speed for Toxic Build-up stacks to allow her to boost her damage output significantly.

builds.name: Big Heals

sets.name: Vanguard
sets.effect:
4pc - All Attack Power +45%.
Effect Hit Rate +20%.

builds.gear_notes: This build allows Shinobu to heal her team more while maintaining high Effect Hit Rate and also Weakness Hit Chance from the main and substats so as to allow her to not only do decent damage but become a great support.

builds.name: Poison those Pookis!
builds.gear_notes: To land Poison better, this build increases her Effect Probability itself to 6 stacks of Poison can be applied more efficiently with her S2.

dedicated.name: Insect Hashira Shinobu Kocho's Nichirin Sword

why_by_stat.DMGAmp: Increases all damage dealt by Shinobu Kocho by the given %, making it useful for both general damage and higher PVE scores. Also increases DOT damage.

dedicated.story: A slender Nichirin Sword infused with poison. The poison mixture can be changed when the blade is returned to its scabbard.

lore:
Shinobu is an Insect Hashira who always wears a smile, even when facing demons.

She is knowledgeable about medicine and pharmacology, and defeats demons using poisons she developed herself. She always smiles while confronting demons, making her difficult to read.
